pairs: Profectusque Israël cum omnibus quæ habebat,
And Israel, setting out with all that he had,
arrived at the Well of the Oath.
et mactatis ibi victimis Deo patris sui Isaac,
And sacrificing victims there to the God of his father Isaac,
audivit eum per visionem noctis vocantem se,
he heard him, by a vision in the night, calling him,
Ego sum fortissimus Deus patris tui:
“I am the most strong God of your father.
quia in gentem magnam faciam te ibi.
for there I will make of you a great nation.
I will descend with you to that place,
et ego inde adducam te revertentem:
and I will lead you back from there,
Joseph quoque ponet manus suas super oculos tuos.
returning. Also, Joseph will place his hands over your eyes.
Surrexit autem Jacob a Puteo juramenti:
Then Jacob rose up from the Well of the Oath.
tuleruntque eum filii cum parvulis et uxoribus suis in plaustris quæ miserat Pharao ad portandum senem,
And his sons took him, with their little ones and wives, in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry the old man,
et omnia quæ possederat in terra Chanaan:
along with all that he possessed in the land of Canaan.
venitque in Ægyptum cum omni semine suo,
And he arrived in Egypt with all his offspring:
Hæc sunt autem nomina filiorum Israël,
Now these are the names of the sons of Israel,
Henoch et Phallu et Hesron et Charmi.
Hanoch and Pallu, and Hezron and Carmi.
and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.
Her et Onan et Sela et Phares et Zara;
Er and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez and Zerah.
mortui sunt autem Her et Onan in terra Chanaan.
Now Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
And sons were born to Perez:
Thola et Phua et Job et Semron.
Tola and Puvah, and Job and Shimron.
Hi filii Liæ quos genuit in Mesopotamia Syriæ cum Dina filia sua:
These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore, along with his daughter Dinah,
omnes animæ filiorum ejus et filiarum, triginta tres.
in Mesopotamia of Syria. All the souls of her sons and daughters are thirty-three.
Filii Gad: Sephion et Haggi et Suni et Esebon et Heri et Arodi et Areli.
The sons of Gad: Ziphion and Haggi, and Shuni and Ezbon, and Eri and Arodi, and Areli.
Jamne et Jesua et Jessui et Beria,
Imnah and Jesua, and Jessui and Beriah,
These are the sons of Zilpah,
quam dedit Laban Liæ filiæ suæ:
whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah.
et hos genuit Jacob sedecim animas.
And these she bore to Jacob: sixteen souls.
Natique sunt Joseph filii in terra Ægypti,
And sons were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, whom Asenath,
quos genuit ei Aseneth filia Putiphare sacerdotis Heliopoleos:
the daughter of Potiphera, priest of Heliopolis, bore for him:
Filii Benjamin: Bela et Bechor et Asbel et Gera et Naaman et Echi et Ros et Mophim et Ophim et Ared.
The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher, and Ashbel and Gera, and Naaman and Ehi, and Rosh and Moppim, and Huppim and Ard.
Hi filii Rachel quos genuit Jacob:
These are the sons of Rachel,
Jasiel et Guni et Jeser et Sallem.
Jahzeel and Guni, and Jezer and Shillem.
Hi filii Balæ, quam dedit Laban Racheli filiæ suæ:
These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel,
and these she bore to Jacob:
Cunctæ animæ, quæ ingressæ sunt cum Jacob in Ægyptum, et egressæ sunt de femore illius,
All the souls who went into Egypt with Jacob and who went out from his thigh,
besides the wives of his sons,
qui nati sunt ei in terra Ægypti,
who were born to him in the land of Egypt,
All the souls of the house of Jacob,
Misit autem Judam ante se ad Joseph,
Then he sent Judah ahead of himself, to Joseph,
in order to report to him,
and so that he would meet him in Goshen.
And when he had arrived there,
ascendit obviam patri suo ad eumdem locum:
and he went up to meet his father at the same place.
he fell upon his neck, and,
And the father said to Joseph,
because I have seen your face,
and I am leaving you behind alive.”
At ille locutus est ad fratres suos,
And he said to his brothers
et ad omnem domum patris sui:
and to all his father’s house:
and I will say to him:
who were in the land of Canaan,
And these honorable men are pastors of sheep,
and they have the task of feeding the flock.
and all that they were able to hold,
And when he will call you
ab infantia nostra usque in præsens,
from our infancy even to the present time,
ut habitare possitis in terra Gessen:
Now you will say this so that you may be able to live in the land of Goshen,
quia detestantur Ægyptii omnes pastores ovium.
because the Egyptians detest all pastors of sheep.”
